values.binNote: This wiki row is just the sum of q_1 (ViktorQ#TotalMissileDamage) and q_2 (ViktorQ#AttackTotalDMG); the bin has no separate calculation for the combined total since the two hits are applied as distinct damage instances.

mechanics.claim: The initial hit shields Viktor for a duration in addition to dealing damage.
mechanics.quote: grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Hitting the target grants Discharge for 4 seconds, empowering the next basic attack.
Discharge converts the next basic attack into a guaranteed-hit, non-projectile attack with modified magic damage instead of the normal on-hit damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Discharge does not convert Spellblade's bonus damage from physical to magic, and disables bonus critical strike damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Discharge'' disables the '''bonus''' damage from {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}}.{{bug}}
